name: menubar
useFor: Use for an app-style command bar over a workspace (Site, Edit, Map) where people expect desktop menus. Keep it to a few short menu names. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: A menubar for site navigation (use Navigation Menu)
Rounded keys or a pill track
A fade when moving between menus
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the Bone cut frame of Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) and the dropdown menu's panel

title: Menubar
description: A Bone frame with the 6px cut corner holding square 32px menu keys (Fog under the pointer and while open), each opening the dropdown menu's panel; moving along the bar is instant.
